title: REQ · ExportSource declares FrozenIDs and FileStore is asserted to implement it
summary: ExportSource interface includes FrozenIDs with compile-time assertion
description: Extend the ExportSource interface in export_source.go with FrozenIDs so the export reads only frozen ids, and keep the var _ ExportSource = (*FileStore)(nil) assertion so the build fails if FileStore lacks it.
acceptance_criteria: Given ExportSource, when inspected, then it declares ListByRound and FrozenIDs
Given the package, when compiled, then the assertion that *FileStore implements ExportSource passes
Given the fake source in tests, when it implements both methods, then it is usable as an ExportSource

preserve: No worker/execution imports in export files

technical_constraints: export_source.go must not import worker or execution packages
